description: Municipal Council Colombo - Notifying that the Budget of the Colombo Municipal Council for the year 2016 & Supplementary Budget for the Year 2015 will be open for Public inspection from 01.12.2015 to 09.12.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the public inspection period for the Colombo Municipal Council's 2016 budget and 2015 supplementary budget. While it involves local government administration, it does not fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) as it is not about land, legal/regulatory matters, commercial affairs, elections, public service, or judicial/law enforcement. It also does not involve central government structural changes, personnel appointments, or portfolio assignments (Types 1-3). This falls under general municipal administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
